strings.about.dependencies:
ExcelDataReader - MIT: reading and verification.
NPOI 2.7.6 - Apache-2.0: local XLS to XLSX conversion.
HtmlAgilityPack 1.12.4 - MIT: HTML reports with the XLS extension.
NSax 1.0.2 - LGPL-3.0-only (NPOI dependency).
Dependency licenses and credits are included in the third-party folder.

strings.setup.connectionExplanation:
Google connection
The app includes the connection configuration. Each person signs in with their own account. A custom JSON is optional. Existing settings are kept.
strings.setup.connectionPrivacy:
Google connection privacy
ZagoSheetsWin uses only the drive.file permission to create and manage files used with the app. Access credentials stay on this computer, protected by Windows, and your spreadsheets are sent directly to Google's APIs - they do not pass through a Zagotools server.
